name: There is Something in the Forest
source:
Everyone deserves a happy ending, don't you think?

But not everyone can have it, the happiness of one can be the misfortune of the other, so which path will you choose?

Remember that everything depends on you, it's all because of you,

[I]I've done it for you...[/i]

[From [url=https://themonsterlive-36.itch.io/there-is-something-in-the-forest]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
每个人都应该有一个幸福的结局，你不觉得吗？

但并不是每个人都能拥有，一个人的幸福可能另一个人的不幸，那么你会选择哪条路呢？

请记住，一切都取决于你，这一切都是因为你，

[I]我已经帮你做好了…[/i]

[来自[url=https://themonsterlive-36.itch.io/there-is-something-in-the-forest]Itch.io[/url]]
